intro.text: The adult human skull has twenty-two bones:
intro.zh: 成人颅骨由 22 块骨组成：

intro.text: eight cranial bones enclose the brain, and fourteen facial bones form the face.
intro.zh: 8 块脑颅骨保护脑，14 块面颅骨构成面部。

frontal.text: Frontal bone. It forms the forehead and brow ridges,
and much of the anterior cranial fossa and orbital roofs.
frontal.zh: 也参与构成颅前窝和眶顶。

parietal.text: Together they form the roof and much of the side walls of the cranium.
parietal.zh: 它们共同构成颅顶及大部分颅侧壁。

temporal.text: Their petrous parts contain the inner ear, with organs of hearing and balance.
temporal.zh: 其岩部容纳内耳，与听觉和平衡有关。

occipital.text: Occipital bone. It forms the back and part of the base of the cranium.
occipital.zh: 枕骨构成颅的后部及部分颅底。

occipital.text: At the foramen magnum, the medulla continues as the spinal cord.
occipital.zh: 延髓在枕骨大孔处与脊髓相续。

sphenoid.text: Sphenoid bone. Shaped like a butterfly,
it sits centrally in the cranial base and contributes to both orbits.
sphenoid.zh: 位于颅底中央，也参与构成两侧眼眶。

ethmoid.text: Ethmoid bone. Light and delicate, it lies between the two orbits.
ethmoid.zh: 筛骨轻而薄，位于两侧眼眶之间。

ethmoid.text: It forms parts of the nasal cavity and the medial orbital walls.
ethmoid.zh: 它参与构成鼻腔和眶内侧壁。

nasal.text: Together they form the bony bridge of the nose.
nasal.zh: 共同构成鼻梁的骨性部分。

lacrimal.text: Lacrimal bones, left and right, are small bones in the medial orbital walls.
lacrimal.zh: 泪骨是位于眶内侧壁的小骨，左右各一块。

lacrimal.text: They contribute to the fossa for the lacrimal sac.

maxilla.text: Maxillae, left and right, form much of the upper jaw.
maxilla.zh: 上颌骨，左右各一块，构成上颌的主体。

maxilla.text: They hold the upper teeth and contain the maxillary sinuses.
maxilla.zh: 它们承托上牙，并容纳上颌窦。

zygomatic.text: Zygomatic bones, left and right, form the cheek prominences.
zygomatic.zh: 颧骨，左右各一块，形成颊部隆起。

zygomatic.text: They also contribute to the orbital walls and zygomatic arches.
zygomatic.zh: 它们也参与构成眶壁和颧弓。

palatine.text: Palatine bones, left and right, form the posterior hard palate.
palatine.zh: 腭骨，左右各一块，构成硬腭后部。

palatine.text: They also contribute to the nasal cavity and a small part of each orbit.
palatine.zh: 它们也参与构成鼻腔及一小部分眶底。

concha.text: Inferior nasal conchae, left and right, are scroll-shaped bones on the lateral nasal walls.
concha.zh: 下鼻甲是鼻腔外侧壁上卷曲的骨，左右各一块。

concha.text: Their mucosal covering helps warm and humidify inspired air.
concha.zh: 其表面的黏膜帮助温暖、湿润吸入的空气。

vomer.zh: 犁骨是位于正中线的单块骨，

vomer.text: it forms the posteroinferior part of the bony nasal septum.
vomer.zh: 构成骨性鼻中隔的后下部。

mandible.text: Mandible. The largest and strongest facial bone,
mandible.zh: 下颌骨是最大、最坚固的面颅骨，

mandible.text: it moves at the temporomandibular joints during chewing and speech.
mandible.zh: 通过颞下颌关节运动，参与咀嚼和发音。

allout.text: Separated, all twenty-two bones are shown in this teaching model.
allout.zh: 分离后，可在教学模型中看到全部 22 块骨。

back.text: And back together: a complete bony skull.
back.zh: 重新组合，构成完整的骨性颅。

end.text: Apart, the individual bones are easier to identify.
end.zh: 分离时，更容易辨认每一块骨。

end.text: Together, they protect the brain and support the face.
end.zh: 组合后，它们保护脑并支撑面部。

intro.text: The skull is not one bone. Most cranial bones meet at sutures.
intro.zh: 颅并非一块骨；多数脑颅骨通过颅缝相接。

intro.text: Foramina and fissures provide routes for nerves and vessels.
intro.zh: 孔和裂为神经、血管提供通道。

coronal.text: The coronal suture joins the frontal bone to the two parietal bones.
coronal.zh: 冠状缝连接额骨与两侧顶骨。

coronal.text: It runs across the top of the skull.
Its junction with the sagittal suture is the bregma.
coronal.zh: 它与矢状缝的交点称前囟点。

sagittal.text: The sagittal suture runs along the midline between the parietal bones.
sagittal.zh: 矢状缝沿正中线走行，连接两侧顶骨。

sagittal.text: It meets the coronal suture at the bregma,
sagittal.zh: 其与冠状缝相交于前囟点，

sagittal.text: and the lambdoid suture at the lambda.
sagittal.zh: 与人字缝相交于人字点。

lambdoid.text: The lambdoid suture joins the parietal bones to the occipital bone.
lambdoid.zh: 人字缝连接顶骨与枕骨。

lambdoid.text: It runs across the posterior skull.
Its junction with the sagittal suture is the lambda.
lambdoid.zh: 它与矢状缝的交点称人字点。

squamous.text: The squamous suture joins the parietal and temporal bones on each side.
squamous.zh: 鳞状缝位于颅侧面，连接顶骨与颞骨。

squamous.text: Its name refers to their overlapping, scale-like edges.
squamous.zh: 其名称描述骨缘呈鳞片状重叠。

pterion.text: The pterion is where frontal, parietal, temporal, and sphenoid bones meet.
pterion.zh: 翼点是额骨、顶骨、颞骨与蝶骨的交汇处。

pterion.text: This is a thin, vulnerable region of the lateral skull.
pterion.zh: 它是颅侧壁较薄、易受损的区域。

pterion.text: A fracture may tear the underlying middle meningeal artery and cause an epidural hematoma.
pterion.zh: 此处骨折可能撕裂深面的脑膜中动脉，引起硬膜外血肿。

cranial-base.text: Now the cranial vault moves away to expose the cranial base.
The floor has three fossae: anterior, middle, and posterior.
cranial-base.zh: 颅底内面分为颅前窝、颅中窝与颅后窝。

cranial-base.text: The following markers indicate selected openings and their approximate regions.
cranial-base.zh: 接下来的标记指示部分开口及其大致区域。

cribriform.text: The cribriform plate of the ethmoid forms part of the nasal roof.
cribriform.zh: 筛骨筛板参与构成鼻腔顶。

cribriform.text: Olfactory nerve filaments pass through its small openings.
cribriform.zh: 嗅神经丝穿过筛板的小孔。

cribriform.text: A fracture may cause loss of smell or a cerebrospinal fluid leak from the nose.
cribriform.zh: 此处骨折可能引起嗅觉丧失或脑脊液鼻漏。

optic-canal.text: The optic canal lies in the lesser wing of the sphenoid.
optic-canal.zh: 视神经管位于蝶骨小翼。

optic-canal.text: It transmits the optic nerve and ophthalmic artery.
optic-canal.zh: 它传导视神经和眼动脉。

optic-canal.text: The optic nerve carries visual signals from the retina toward the brain.
optic-canal.zh: 视神经将视觉信号从视网膜传向脑。

sof.text: The superior orbital fissure lies between the sphenoid wings.
sof.zh: 眶上裂位于蝶骨大、小翼之间。

sof.text: It transmits cranial nerves three, four, and six,
sof.zh: 动眼神经、滑车神经和展神经经过此裂，

sof.text: the ophthalmic division of nerve five, and the superior ophthalmic vein.
sof.zh: 还有三叉神经眼支和眼上静脉。

sphenoid-trio.text: Three important openings in the greater wing of the sphenoid.
sphenoid-trio.zh: 蝶骨大翼上的三个重要开口。

sphenoid-trio.text: The foramen rotundum transmits the maxillary nerve, the second trigeminal division.
sphenoid-trio.zh: 圆孔传导三叉神经第二支：上颌神经。

sphenoid-trio.text: The foramen ovale transmits the mandibular division.
The foramen spinosum transmits the middle meningeal artery. These markers are schematic.
sphenoid-trio.zh: 棘孔传导脑膜中动脉；这里的标记为示意定位。

iam.text: The internal acoustic meatus opens on the petrous temporal bone.
It carries the facial and vestibulocochlear nerves and the labyrinthine artery.
iam.zh: 内耳道传导面神经、前庭蜗神经及迷路动脉。

iam.text: The facial nerve continues into the facial canal.
iam.zh: 面神经随后进入面神经管。

iam.text: Temporal bone trauma may cause facial weakness, hearing loss, or vertigo.
iam.zh: 颞骨外伤可能导致面肌无力、听力下降或眩晕。

posterior-base.text: The foramen magnum transmits the brainstem continuing as the spinal cord,
posterior-base.zh: 枕骨大孔容纳脑干与脊髓的移行部，

posterior-base.text: the vertebral arteries, and spinal roots of the accessory nerve.
posterior-base.zh: 也有椎动脉和副神经脊髓根通过。

posterior-base.text: The jugular foramen carries nerves nine, ten, and eleven and venous drainage.
posterior-base.zh: 颈静脉孔传导第九、十、十一脑神经及静脉回流。

posterior-base.text: The hypoglossal canal transmits the twelfth nerve.
posterior-base.zh: 舌下神经管传导第十二脑神经。

facial-cluster.text: The small facial bones include lacrimal, palatine, inferior nasal concha, vomer, and nasal bones.
facial-cluster.zh: 小面颅骨包括泪骨、腭骨、下鼻甲、犁骨和鼻骨。

facial-cluster.text: They contribute to the orbits, nasal cavity, nasal septum, and palate.
facial-cluster.zh: 它们参与构成眼眶、鼻腔、鼻中隔和腭。

facial-cluster.text: Each has a different role; they do not all form the same wall.
facial-cluster.zh: 它们分工不同，并非都构成同一面壁。

recap.text: Sutures join bones. Foramina and fissures let nerves and vessels pass.
recap.zh: 颅缝连接骨，孔和裂供神经与血管通过。

recap.text: Relate each opening to its contents, then confirm its position in an anatomical atlas.
recap.zh: 将开口与穿行结构联系起来，再结合解剖图谱确认位置。

intro.text: Episodes one and two introduced the bones, sutures, and openings.
intro.zh: 前两集介绍了骨、颅缝及开口。

intro.text: Now we connect these landmarks to the cranial nerves, orbit, and jaw.
intro.zh: 这一集将它们与脑神经、眼眶和下颌联系起来。

intro.text: We then review selected facial fractures and signs of skull-base injury.
intro.zh: 最后学习部分面部骨折及颅底损伤体征。

cn-front.text: Twelve cranial nerves use several routes through the skull.
cn-front.zh: 十二对脑神经经不同通道穿行于颅。

cn-front.text: Olfactory filaments cross the cribriform plate; the optic nerve uses the optic canal.
cn-front.zh: 嗅神经丝经过筛板；视神经经过视神经管。

cn-front.text: Nerves three, four, and six, with the ophthalmic division of five,
cn-front.zh: 第三、四、六脑神经及第五脑神经的眼支，

cn-front.text: pass through the superior orbital fissure.

cn-middle.text: The maxillary division of nerve five passes through the foramen rotundum.
cn-middle.zh: 三叉神经上颌支经过圆孔。

cn-middle.text: The mandibular division passes through the foramen ovale.
The internal carotid artery enters through the carotid canal,
cn-middle.zh: 颈内动脉经颈动脉管进入颅内，

cn-middle.text: then passes over the cartilage-filled foramen lacerum, not through its full depth.
cn-middle.zh: 随后经过充填软骨的破裂孔上方，而非纵贯该孔。

cn-back.text: The facial and vestibulocochlear nerves enter the internal acoustic meatus together.
cn-back.zh: 面神经与前庭蜗神经一同进入内耳道。

cn-back.text: The facial nerve then follows the facial canal.
cn-back.zh: 面神经随后沿面神经管走行。

cn-back.text: It exits through the stylomastoid foramen.
Nerves nine, ten, and eleven use the jugular foramen; twelve uses the hypoglossal canal.
cn-back.zh: 第九、十、十一脑神经经过颈静脉孔；第十二经舌下神经管。

cn-table.text: This overview groups ten selected routes used by cranial nerves.
cn-table.zh: 此总表归纳了脑神经使用的十处通道。

cn-table.text: Use it to organize your anatomy study, alongside an atlas and cross-sectional images.
cn-table.zh: 请结合解剖图谱和断层影像学习这些对应关系。

orbit-room.text: The orbit is a cavity built from seven bones.
orbit-room.zh: 眼眶是由七块骨参与构成的腔隙。

orbit-room.text: Its broad opening faces forward and its apex points backward.
orbit-room.zh: 宽大的眶口朝前，眶尖朝后。

orbit-room.text: It contains the eye, extraocular muscles, nerves, vessels, fat, and lacrimal structures.
orbit-room.zh: 眶内容物包括眼球、眼外肌、神经、血管、脂肪及泪器结构。

orbit-walls.text: The roof: frontal bone and lesser wing of the sphenoid.
The floor: maxilla, zygomatic, and a small contribution from palatine.
orbit-walls.zh: 眶底：上颌骨、颧骨及少量腭骨。

orbit-walls.text: The medial wall: ethmoid, lacrimal, maxilla, and sphenoid.
orbit-walls.zh: 眶内侧壁：筛骨、泪骨、上颌骨和蝶骨。

orbit-walls.text: The lateral wall: zygomatic and greater wing of the sphenoid.
orbit-walls.zh: 眶外侧壁：颧骨与蝶骨大翼。

orbit-apex.text: The optic canal transmits the optic nerve and ophthalmic artery.
orbit-apex.zh: 视神经管传导视神经和眼动脉。

orbit-apex.text: The superior orbital fissure transmits nerves three, four, six, and the ophthalmic division of five.
orbit-apex.zh: 眶上裂传导第三、四、六脑神经及三叉神经眼支。

orbit-apex.text: The inferior orbital fissure transmits infraorbital and zygomatic branches of the maxillary nerve,
orbit-apex.zh: 眶下裂传导上颌神经的眶下支和颧支，

orbit-apex.text: with vessels connecting the orbit to adjacent spaces.
orbit-apex.zh: 也有血管经过，连通眼眶与邻近间隙。

tmj.text: The temporomandibular joint connects the mandible to the temporal bone.
tmj.zh: 颞下颌关节连接下颌骨与颞骨。

tmj.text: A fibrocartilaginous disc separates its joint spaces.
tmj.zh: 纤维软骨性关节盘分隔关节腔。

tmj.text: Rotation and translation allow opening, chewing, and speech.
tmj.zh: 转动与滑动共同实现张口、咀嚼和发音。

tmj-dislocation.text: In an anterior dislocation, the mandibular condyle moves beyond the articular eminence.
tmj-dislocation.zh: 前脱位时，下颌髁突移至关节结节前方。
患者可能张口后无法闭合。

tmj-dislocation.text: A blow to the chin can instead fracture the condylar region.
tmj-dislocation.zh: 颏部受撞击则可能造成髁突区骨折。

tmj-nerve.text: The inferior alveolar nerve enters the mandibular foramen and supplies the lower teeth.
tmj-nerve.zh: 下牙槽神经经下颌孔进入，支配下牙感觉。

tmj-nerve.text: Its mental branch exits through the mental foramen to the lower lip and chin.
tmj-nerve.zh: 其颏支经颏孔穿出，支配下唇与颏部感觉。

tmj-nerve.text: A mental nerve block numbs these soft tissues, not the teeth.
tmj-nerve.zh: 颏神经阻滞麻醉这些软组织，不麻醉牙齿。

lefort-1.text: Le Fort one is a horizontal maxillary fracture above the teeth.
lefort-1.zh: Le Fort I 型为牙列上方的水平上颌骨骨折。

lefort-1.text: It separates the tooth-bearing maxilla and hard palate from the upper face.
lefort-1.zh: 它使含牙上颌骨及硬腭与上方面部结构分离。

lefort-1.text: All classic Le Fort patterns involve the pterygoid plates, beyond this front-view schematic.
lefort-1.zh: 经典 Le Fort 骨折均累及翼突板，正面示意线未完整展示。

lefort-2.text: Le Fort two is a pyramidal midface fracture.
lefort-2.zh: Le Fort II 型是锥形的面中部骨折。

lefort-2.text: It crosses the nasal bridge, medial orbits, and inferior orbital rims,
lefort-2.zh: 骨折线经过鼻梁、眶内侧及眶下缘，

lefort-2.text: and extends through the maxilla toward the pterygoid plates.
lefort-2.zh: 并经上颌骨延伸至翼突板。

lefort-3.text: Le Fort three causes craniofacial disjunction.
lefort-3.zh: Le Fort III 型可造成颅面分离。

lefort-3.text: Fractures cross the nasofrontal region, orbital walls, and zygomatic arches,
lefort-3.zh: 骨折线经过鼻额区、眶壁和颧弓，

lefort-3.text: with pterygoid plate involvement. Actual trauma patterns may be asymmetric or mixed.
lefort-3.zh: 并累及翼突板；实际损伤可不对称或呈混合类型。

battle-raccoon.text: Battle's sign is bruising over the mastoid, suggesting skull-base injury.
battle-raccoon.zh: Battle 征为乳突区瘀斑，提示颅底损伤。

battle-raccoon.text: Bilateral raccoon eyes raise concern for an anterior skull-base fracture.
battle-raccoon.zh: 双侧熊猫眼征提示警惕前颅底骨折。

battle-raccoon.text: These signs may be delayed and do not establish the diagnosis alone.
battle-raccoon.zh: 这些体征可能延迟出现，不能单独确诊。

battle-raccoon.text: Their absence does not exclude a fracture.
battle-raccoon.zh: 未出现这些体征，也不能排除骨折。

csf-leak.text: A confirmed cerebrospinal fluid leak indicates a dural defect.
csf-leak.zh: 经确认的脑脊液漏提示硬脑膜缺损。

csf-leak.text: Clear fluid from the nose or ear after trauma is suspicious, but not diagnostic.
csf-leak.zh: 外伤后鼻或耳流清液应怀疑脑脊液漏，但不能仅凭外观确诊。

csf-leak.text: Urgent assessment is needed because a persistent leak can increase meningitis risk.
csf-leak.zh: 应及时评估，持续漏液会增加脑膜炎风险。

csf-leak.text: Leakage may start hours or days after injury.
csf-leak.zh: 漏液可能在伤后数小时或数日才出现。

recap.text: Twenty-two bones, selected nerve pathways, the orbit, and the jaw.
recap.zh: 22 块骨、部分神经通道、眼眶与下颌。

recap.text: These models help build a spatial map.
recap.zh: 这些模型帮助建立空间概念。

recap.text: Use them alongside anatomical references; schematic markers are not diagnostic imaging.
recap.zh: 请结合解剖资料学习；示意标记不能替代诊断影像。
